resolved.rationale: Reviewer A claims: IPv6 Support Implementation
Reviewer A claims: Severity: Medium
Reviewer A claims: File: pkg/proxy/nftables/proxier.go, pkg/proxy/nftables/proxier_test.go

Reviewer A claims: Description: The diff adds IPv6 support but doesn't fully validate IPv6 address handling in all scenarios. The test cases cover basic functionality but don't test edge cases like invalid IPv6 addresses or malformed input.
Reviewer A claims: DNAT Rule Format Change
Reviewer A claims: Severity: Low
Reviewer A claims: File: pkg/proxy/nftables/proxier.go (line 1939-1942)

Reviewer A claims: Description: The DNAT rule format was changed from "dnat ipX addr . port to" to "dnat to" with net.JoinHostPort(). While this is cleaner, there's no validation that all nftables versions support this format.
Reviewer A claims: Test Coverage
Reviewer A claims: Severity: Medium
Reviewer A claims: File: pkg/proxy/nftables/proxier_test.go
Reviewer A claims: Description: The new IPv6 test cases don't cover all the same scenarios as the IPv4 tests. For example, there's no IPv6 equivalent of the TestBadIPs test case.
Reviewer A claims: Code Duplication
Reviewer A claims: Severity: Low
Reviewer A claims: File: pkg/proxy/nftables/proxier_test.go
Reviewer A claims: Description: The IPv4 and IPv6 test cases are nearly identical copies with just address changes. This could be refactored to reduce duplication.
Reviewer A claims: Backward Compatibility
Reviewer A claims: The DNAT rule format change could potentially break compatibility with older nftables versions. This should be verified.
Reviewer A claims: Performance Impact
Reviewer A claims: The additional IPv6 support could impact performance, though this would likely be minimal. No benchmarks are provided.
Reviewer A claims: Error Handling
Reviewer A claims: The code doesn't show how invalid IPv6 addresses would be handled. This could lead to uncaught errors in production.
Reviewer A claims: Add more test cases for IPv6 edge cases
Reviewer A claims: Consider refactoring test code to reduce duplication
Reviewer A claims: Verify backward compatibility of DNAT rule format change
Reviewer A claims: Add benchmarks for IPv6 performance impact
Reviewer A claims: Add error handling for invalid IPv6 addresses

Reviewer B claims: Severity**: Medium
Reviewer B claims: Evidence References**:
